arguments: {"thesis_id": "th_b68da91ac4954af882b3", "expected_version": 1, "alert_id": "fa_c58cde0dcdfa4330b9c9", "event": {"summary": "MQ Q3 selected SEC exhibit rows compared sequentially with Q2 selected rows: GAAP revenue, gross profit and gross margin rose, company-reported TPV and company-defined Adjusted EBITDA rose, while GAAP operating loss, pretax loss and net loss widened and other income declined.", "type": "earnings", "as_of": "2025-11-05", "sources": [{"id": "RS-MQ-Q2", "url": "https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1522540/000152254025000020/mqearningsrelease-q2x2025.htm", "sha256": "c3640fe7acbf7760613b8e448197d174ab091a0e1689c8f623a4385b39da32d9"}, {"id": "RS-MQ-Q3", "url": "https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1522540/000152254025000033/mqearningsrelease-q3x2025.htm", "sha256": "7f6cd2d4c29088472d522a65c6df8ba10769349191f7f5da71399ff1da7b9d0f"}]}, "impact": "mixed", "decision": "needs_review", "rationale": "The selected rows show a mixed sequential picture rather than a clean improvement or deterioration. Top-line GAAP revenue and gross profit grew, and the company-reported rounded gross margin moved up, while company-reported processing volume and the company-defined Adjusted EBITDA reconciliation also rose. Against that, the GAAP operating result remained a loss and widened, the pretax and net results deteriorated, and other income fell, so the GAAP bottom line did not follow the top line. The widening of the operating loss alongside higher gross profit points to operating expense growth, with the largest single-step increase appearing in the other operating expenses line, but the selected rows do not identify what drove that line, and the arithmetic contribution is not evidence of causation. The divergence between the improving company-defined Adjusted EBITDA and the deteriorating GAAP operating and net results is unresolved: the selected extract does not show the full reconciliation items, so the gap between the two bases cannot be attributed. The rounded gross margin disclosure is a company-reported rounded figure and cannot be treated as a precise margin bridge. All comparisons are sequential displayed-value arithmetic between two calendar quarters, not year-over-year comparisons, and no guidance, consensus expectation, or realized-versus-guided comparison is present in the selected rows, so no beat or miss characterization is supported. The extract is a set of selected exhibit rows, not complete filings, so nothing here establishes that any item is absent from the filings themselves. Because the GAAP profitability trend and the company-defined profitability trend point in opposite directions and the drivers are unidentified, the research state is held for review rather than upgraded or invalidated; the thesis remains blocked pending source evidence that reconciles the two bases and explains the operating expense step-up.", "evidence": [{"id": "RS-MQ-Q2", "kind": "sec_exhibit", "url": "https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1522540/000152254025000020/mqearningsrelease-q2x2025.htm", "sha256": "c3640fe7acbf7760613b8e448197d174ab091a0e1689c8f623a4385b39da32d9", "period": "CY2025_Q2", "note": "Baseline selected SEC exhibit rows for the quarter ended 2025-06-30"}, {"id": "RS-MQ-Q3", "kind": "sec_exhibit", "url": "https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1522540/000152254025000033/mqearningsrelease-q3x2025.htm", "sha256": "7f6cd2d4c29088472d522a65c6df8ba10769349191f7f5da71399ff1da7b9d0f", "period": "CY2025_Q3", "note": "Event selected SEC exhibit rows for the quarter ended 2025-09-30"}], "matched_terms": ["earnings", "gaap_net_revenue", "gaap_gross_profit", "gaap_operating_income_loss", "gaap_net_income_loss", "company_total_processing_volume", "non_gaap_adjusted_ebitda", "reported_gross_margin"], "causal_claims": []}
